{erl_opts, [debug_info, warn_unused_import, warn_unused_vars]}.

{deps, [
    {jsx, "3.1.0"},
    {eredis, "1.7.1"},
    %% Trusted provider ingress only. Tenant code never imports Cowboy.
    %% Cowboy's Hex metadata expresses cowlib ranges that Rebar3 3.24 rejects.
    %% Pin the upstream source tag, whose rebar.config pins exact cowlib/ranch tags.
    {cowboy, ".*", {git, "https://github.com/ninenines/cowboy", {tag, "2.14.2"}}}
]}.

{eunit_opts, [verbose]}.
{xref_checks, [undefined_function_calls, undefined_functions, locals_not_used]}.

%% Production guest images consume a self-contained release rather than source
%% trees or a host-installed Erlang runtime. No distributed node name is set;
%% the shared-hosting guest is intentionally non-distributed and reached only
%% through the loopback guest-control bridge.
{relx, [
    {release, {bmscl_supervisor, "0.1.0"}, [bmscl_supervisor, sasl]},
    {dev_mode, false},
    {include_erts, true},
    {extended_start_script, true}
]}.

-module(bmscl_artifact).

-export([verify/1, verify_provenance/2]).

-define(PROFILE_V2, <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-v2-read-only">>).
-define(PROFILE_V3_HTTP, <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-v3-http-capability">>).
-define(PROFILE_DURABLE_V1, <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-durable-actor-v1">>).
-define(PROFILE_CRITICAL_ERLANG_V1, <<"bmscl-critical-section-erlang-v1">>).
-define(LEGACY_PROFILE, <<"bmscl-hosted-gleam-v1">>).
-define(ENTRYPOINT, <<"worker:handle/2">>).
-define(PROVENANCE_FORMAT, <<"bmscl-build-provenance-v1">>).
-define(MODULE_CONTRACT_V1, <<"bmscl-module-contract-v1">>).
-define(CONTEXT_ABI_V1, <<"bmscl.context/v1">>).

-spec verify(file:filename_all()) -> {ok, map()} | {error, term()}.
verify(ArtifactDir0) ->
    ArtifactDir = filename:absname(ArtifactDir0),
    try
        ManifestPath = filename:join(ArtifactDir, "manifest.json"),
        AdmissionPath = filename:join(ArtifactDir, "admission-report.json"),
        ManifestBytes = read_required_file(ManifestPath),
        AdmissionBytes = read_required_file(AdmissionPath),
        ok = bmscl_attestation:verify(ArtifactDir, ManifestBytes, AdmissionBytes),
        Manifest = decode_json_bytes(ManifestPath, ManifestBytes),
        Admission = decode_json_bytes(AdmissionPath, AdmissionBytes),
        ok = verify_manifest(Manifest),
        ok = verify_admission(Manifest, Admission),
        Provenance = verify_artifact_provenance(ArtifactDir, Manifest),
        BeamDir = filename:join(ArtifactDir, "beam"),
        {ok, ModuleFiles} = read_beams(BeamDir),
        %% Preserve the existing signed-artifact error contract: integrity of
        %% the exact BEAM bytes is checked before structural admission. The atom
        %% gate still runs strictly before any tenant code can be loaded.
        ok = verify_build_digest(Manifest, ModuleFiles),
        {ok, StaticAtomCount} = bmscl_beam_static_limits:verify(ModuleFiles),
        Names = [Name || {Name, _Path, _Bin} <- ModuleFiles],
        ok = verify_module_names(Names),
        ok = verify_trusted_sdk_modules(Names, Provenance),
        true = lists:member(<<"worker">>, Names),
        Limits = normalize_limits(maps:get(<<"runtime_limits">>, Manifest)),
        Capabilities = normalize_capabilities(maps:get(<<"capabilities">>, Manifest, [])),
        Profile = maps:get(<<"profile">>, Manifest),
        Durable = normalize_durable(Profile, maps:get(<<"durable">>, Manifest, undefined)),
        {ok, #{
            deployment_id => maps:get(<<"build_sha256">>, Manifest),
            source_sha256 => maps:get(<<"source_sha256">>, Manifest),
            module_files => ModuleFiles,
            module_names => Names,
            static_atom_count => StaticAtomCount,
            entrypoint_module => <<"worker">>,
            entrypoint_function => handle,
            runtime_limits => Limits,
            capabilities => Capabilities,
            profile => Profile,
            durable => Durable,
            provenance => Provenance,
            manifest => Manifest
        }}
    catch
        error:{badmatch, false} -> {error, missing_worker_entrypoint};
        error:{badmatch, {error, Reason}} -> {error, Reason};
        error:{badkey, Key} -> {error, {missing_manifest_key, Key}};
        error:Reason -> {error, Reason};
        throw:Reason -> {error, Reason}
    end.

read_required_file(Path) ->
    case file:read_file(Path) of
        {ok, Bytes} -> Bytes;
        {error, Reason} -> error({artifact_file_read_failed, Path, Reason})
    end.

decode_json_bytes(Path, Bytes) ->
    try jsx:decode(Bytes, [return_maps])
    catch _:_ -> error({invalid_json, Path})
    end.

verify_manifest(M) ->
    Version = maps:get(<<"format_version">>, M),
    Require = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_attestation, true),
    case {Require, Version} of
        {true, 2} -> ok;
        {true, _} -> error({legacy_artifact_forbidden, Version});
        {false, 1} -> ok;
        {false, 2} -> ok;
        {false, _} -> error({unsupported_artifact_format, Version})
    end,
    require_equal(runtime, <<"beam">>, maps:get(<<"runtime">>, M)),
    Language = maps:get(<<"language">>, M),
    Profile = maps:get(<<"profile">>, M),
    require_language_profile(Language, Profile),
    require_profile(Profile),
    ok = verify_module_context_contract(Version, M),
    _Durable = normalize_durable(Profile, maps:get(<<"durable">>, M, undefined)),
    require_equal(entrypoint, ?ENTRYPOINT, maps:get(<<"entrypoint">>, M)),
    Source = maps:get(<<"source_sha256">>, M),
    Build = maps:get(<<"build_sha256">>, M),
    true = valid_sha256(Source),
    true = valid_sha256(Build),
    case Version of
        2 -> true = valid_sha256(maps:get(<<"provenance_sha256">>, M));
        1 -> ok
    end,
    Limits = normalize_limits(maps:get(<<"runtime_limits">>, M)),
    require_equal(max_processes, 1, maps:get(max_processes, Limits)),
    ok = bmscl_limits:validate_runtime_limits(Limits),
    Capabilities = normalize_capabilities(maps:get(<<"capabilities">>, M, [])),
    CapabilityNames = lists:sort(bmscl_capability_scope:names(Capabilities)),
    require_capabilities(Profile, CapabilityNames),
    ok.

verify_module_context_contract(1, _Manifest) ->
    ok;
verify_module_context_contract(2, Manifest) ->
    Contract = maps:get(<<"module_contract_version">>, Manifest, undefined),
    ContextAbi = maps:get(<<"context_abi">>, Manifest, undefined),
    Require = application:get_env(
                bmscl_supervisor, require_module_context_contract, false),
    case {Contract, ContextAbi, Require} of
        {?MODULE_CONTRACT_V1, ?CONTEXT_ABI_V1, _} -> ok;
        {undefined, undefined, false} -> ok;
        {undefined, undefined, true} -> error(missing_module_context_contract);
        {undefined, _, _} -> error(partial_module_context_contract);
        {_, undefined, _} -> error(partial_module_context_contract);
        _ -> error({unsupported_module_context_contract, Contract, ContextAbi})
    end.

require_language_profile(<<"gleam">>, ?PROFILE_V2) -> ok;
require_language_profile(<<"gleam">>, ?PROFILE_V3_HTTP) -> ok;
require_language_profile(<<"gleam">>, ?PROFILE_DURABLE_V1) -> ok;
require_language_profile(<<"gleam">>, ?LEGACY_PROFILE) -> ok;
require_language_profile(<<"erlang">>, ?PROFILE_CRITICAL_ERLANG_V1) -> ok;
require_language_profile(Language, Profile) ->
    error({unsupported_language_profile, Language, Profile}).

require_profile(?PROFILE_V2) -> ok;
require_profile(?PROFILE_V3_HTTP) -> ok;
require_profile(?PROFILE_DURABLE_V1) -> ok;
require_profile(?PROFILE_CRITICAL_ERLANG_V1) -> ok;
require_profile(?LEGACY_PROFILE) ->
    case legacy_dev_artifact_allowed() of
        true -> ok;
        false -> require_equal(profile, ?PROFILE_V2, ?LEGACY_PROFILE)
    end;
require_profile(Actual) ->
    error({unsupported_hosted_profile, Actual}).

require_capabilities(?PROFILE_V2, CapabilityNames) ->
    require_equal(capability_names,
                  lists:sort([<<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"ctx.log">>]), CapabilityNames);
require_capabilities(?PROFILE_V3_HTTP, CapabilityNames) ->
    require_equal(capability_names,
                  lists:sort([<<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"ctx.http">>, <<"ctx.log">>]),
                  CapabilityNames);
require_capabilities(?PROFILE_DURABLE_V1, CapabilityNames) ->
    require_equal(capability_names,
                  lists:sort([<<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"ctx.log">>]), CapabilityNames);
require_capabilities(?PROFILE_CRITICAL_ERLANG_V1, CapabilityNames) ->
    require_equal(capability_names,
                  lists:sort([<<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"ctx.log">>]), CapabilityNames);
require_capabilities(?LEGACY_PROFILE, CapabilityNames) ->
    true = legacy_dev_artifact_allowed(),
    require_equal(capability_names, [], CapabilityNames).

legacy_dev_artifact_allowed() ->
    application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_admission_receipt, true) =:= false andalso
    application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_attestation, true) =:= false andalso
    application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_trusted_build_provenance, true) =:= false.

verify_admission(M, A) ->
    require_equal(admitted, true, maps:get(<<"admitted">>, A)),
    Profile = maps:get(<<"profile">>, M),
    require_equal(policy_version, Profile, maps:get(<<"policy_version">>, A)),
    require_equal(source_sha256, maps:get(<<"source_sha256">>, M), maps:get(<<"source_sha256">>, A)),
    require_equal(runtime_limits,
                  normalize_limits(maps:get(<<"runtime_limits">>, M)),
                  normalize_limits(maps:get(<<"runtime_limits">>, A))),
    require_equal(durable,
                  normalize_durable(Profile, maps:get(<<"durable">>, M, undefined)),
                  normalize_durable(Profile, maps:get(<<"durable">>, A, undefined))),
    ok.

verify_artifact_provenance(ArtifactDir, Manifest) ->
    case maps:get(<<"format_version">>, Manifest) of
        1 -> undefined;
        2 ->
            Path = filename:join(ArtifactDir, "provenance.json"),
            Bytes = read_required_file(Path),
            Expected = maps:get(<<"provenance_sha256">>, Manifest),
            require_equal(provenance_sha256, Expected, sha256_hex(Bytes)),
            Provenance = decode_json_bytes(Path, Bytes),
            ok = verify_provenance(Manifest, Provenance),
            Provenance
    end.

-spec verify_provenance(map(), map()) -> ok | no_return().
verify_provenance(Manifest, Provenance) ->
    require_equal(provenance_format, ?PROVENANCE_FORMAT,
                  maps:get(<<"format">>, Provenance)),
    require_equal(provenance_source_sha256,
                  maps:get(<<"source_sha256">>, Manifest),
                  maps:get(<<"source_sha256">>, Provenance)),
    require_equal(provenance_build_sha256,
                  maps:get(<<"build_sha256">>, Manifest),
                  maps:get(<<"build_sha256">>, Provenance)),
    BuilderId = maps:get(<<"builder_id">>, Provenance),
    BuilderImage = maps:get(<<"builder_image_digest">>, Provenance),
    CompilerVersion = maps:get(<<"compiler_version">>, Provenance),
    CompilerRevision = maps:get(<<"compiler_revision">>, Provenance),
    GleamVersion = maps:get(<<"gleam_version">>, Provenance),
    OtpRelease = maps:get(<<"otp_release">>, Provenance),
    ErtsVersion = maps:get(<<"erts_version">>, Provenance),
    PolicySha = maps:get(<<"policy_sha256">>, Provenance),
    DependencyLockSha = maps:get(<<"dependency_lock_sha256">>, Provenance, null),
    TrustedSdkSha = maps:get(<<"trusted_sdk_sha256">>, Provenance, null),
    true = valid_identifier(BuilderId),
    true = valid_image_digest(BuilderImage),
    true = valid_tool_version(CompilerVersion),
    true = valid_git_revision(CompilerRevision),
    true = valid_tool_version(GleamVersion),
    true = valid_tool_version(OtpRelease),
    true = valid_tool_version(ErtsVersion),
    true = valid_sha256(PolicySha),
    true = valid_optional_sha256(DependencyLockSha),
    true = valid_optional_sha256(TrustedSdkSha),
    RequireTrustedBuild = application:get_env(
        bmscl_supervisor,
        require_trusted_build_provenance,
        application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_attestation, true)),
    case RequireTrustedBuild of
        true ->
            require_trusted(builder_id, BuilderId, trusted_builder_ids),
            require_trusted(builder_image_digest, BuilderImage, trusted_builder_image_digests),
            require_trusted(policy_sha256, PolicySha, trusted_policy_sha256),
            require_trusted(compiler_revision, CompilerRevision, trusted_compiler_revisions),
            case maps:get(<<"language">>, Manifest) of
                <<"gleam">> ->
                    require_trusted(gleam_version, GleamVersion, trusted_gleam_versions);
                <<"erlang">> ->
                    ok
            end,
            require_trusted(otp_release, OtpRelease, trusted_otp_releases),
            require_trusted(erts_version, ErtsVersion, trusted_erts_versions),
            case TrustedSdkSha of
                null -> ok;
                _ -> require_trusted(trusted_sdk_sha256, TrustedSdkSha, trusted_sdk_sha256)
            end;
        false -> ok
    end,
    ok.

require_trusted(Field, Value, EnvKey) ->
    Configured = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, EnvKey, []),
    case is_list(Configured) andalso
         lists:member(Value, [normalize_binary(V) || V <- Configured]) of
        true -> ok;
        false -> error({untrusted_provenance, Field, Value})
    end.

normalize_limits(L) ->
    Wall = positive_integer(max_wall_ms, maps:get(<<"max_wall_ms">>, L)),
    Reductions = positive_integer(max_reductions, maps:get(<<"max_reductions">>, L)),
    Heap = positive_integer(max_heap_bytes, maps:get(<<"max_heap_bytes">>, L)),
    Processes = positive_integer(max_processes, maps:get(<<"max_processes">>, L)),
    #{max_wall_ms => Wall,
      max_reductions => Reductions,
      max_heap_bytes => Heap,
      max_processes => Processes}.

normalize_capabilities(Capabilities) ->
    bmscl_capability_scope:normalize_grants(Capabilities).

normalize_durable(?PROFILE_DURABLE_V1, Durable) when is_map(Durable) ->
    Namespace = maps:get(<<"namespace">>, Durable),
    case valid_durable_namespace(Namespace) of
        true -> ok;
        false -> error({invalid_durable_namespace, Namespace})
    end,
    VirtualShards = bounded_integer(
                      virtual_shards, maps:get(<<"virtual_shards">>, Durable), 64, 65536),
    ShardsPerActor = bounded_integer(
                       shards_per_actor, maps:get(<<"shards_per_actor">>, Durable), 1, 4096),
    case ShardsPerActor =< VirtualShards
         andalso VirtualShards rem ShardsPerActor =:= 0 of
        true ->
            #{namespace => Namespace,
              virtual_shards => VirtualShards,
              shards_per_actor => ShardsPerActor};
        false ->
            error({invalid_durable_shard_layout, VirtualShards, ShardsPerActor})
    end;
normalize_durable(?PROFILE_DURABLE_V1, Value) ->
    error({invalid_durable_config, Value});
normalize_durable(_Profile, undefined) -> undefined;
normalize_durable(_Profile, null) -> undefined;
normalize_durable(Profile, Value) ->
    error({durable_config_forbidden, Profile, Value}).

valid_durable_namespace(Value) when is_binary(Value),
                                    byte_size(Value) >= 1,
                                    byte_size(Value) =< 128 ->
    re:run(Value, <<"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$">>, [{capture, none}]) =:= match;
valid_durable_namespace(_) -> false.

bounded_integer(_Name, V, Min, Max)
  when is_integer(V), V >= Min, V =< Max -> V;
bounded_integer(Name, V, Min, Max) ->
    error({invalid_bounded_integer, Name, V, Min, Max}).

positive_integer(_Name, V) when is_integer(V), V > 0 -> V;
positive_integer(Name, V) -> error({invalid_positive_limit, Name, V}).

require_equal(_Name, V, V) -> ok;
require_equal(Name, Expected, Actual) -> error({artifact_contract_mismatch, Name, Expected, Actual}).

valid_sha256(B) when is_binary(B), byte_size(B) =:= 64 ->
    re:run(B, <<"^[0-9a-f]{64}$">>, [{capture, none}]) =:= match;
valid_sha256(_) -> false.
valid_optional_sha256(null) -> true;
valid_optional_sha256(Value) -> valid_sha256(Value).
valid_identifier(B) when is_binary(B), byte_size(B) >= 1, byte_size(B) =< 128 ->
    re:run(B, <<"^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]+$">>, [{capture, none}]) =:= match;
valid_identifier(_) -> false.
valid_image_digest(B) when is_binary(B) ->
    re:run(B, <<"^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$">>, [{capture, none}]) =:= match;
valid_image_digest(_) -> false.
valid_git_revision(B) when is_binary(B) ->
    re:run(B, <<"^[0-9a-f]{40,64}$">>, [{capture, none}]) =:= match;
valid_git_revision(_) -> false.
valid_tool_version(B) when is_binary(B), byte_size(B) >= 1, byte_size(B) =< 64 ->
    re:run(B, <<"^[A-Za-z0-9._+:-]+$">>, [{capture, none}]) =:= match;
valid_tool_version(_) -> false.

read_beams(BeamDir) ->
    case file:list_dir(BeamDir) of
        {ok, Entries0} ->
            Entries = lists:sort([E || E <- Entries0, filename:extension(E) =:= ".beam"]),
            case Entries of
                [] -> {error, no_beam_modules};
                _ -> read_beams(BeamDir, Entries, [])
            end;
        {error, Reason} -> {error, {beam_dir_read_failed, BeamDir, Reason}}
    end.
read_beams(_Dir, [], Acc) -> {ok, lists:reverse(Acc)};
read_beams(Dir, [File | Rest], Acc) ->
    Path = filename:join(Dir, File),
    case file:read_file(Path) of
        {ok, Bin} ->
            Name = unicode:characters_to_binary(filename:rootname(File, ".beam")),
            read_beams(Dir, Rest, [{Name, Path, Bin} | Acc]);
        {error, Reason} -> {error, {beam_read_failed, Path, Reason}}
    end.

verify_build_digest(Manifest, ModuleFiles) ->
    Ctx0 = crypto:hash_init(sha256),
    Ctx = lists:foldl(
      fun({Name, _Path, Bin}, C0) ->
          Filename = <<Name/binary, ".beam">>,
          C1 = crypto:hash_update(C0, Filename),
          C2 = crypto:hash_update(C1, <<0>>),
          C3 = crypto:hash_update(C2, Bin),
          crypto:hash_update(C3, <<0>>)
      end, Ctx0, ModuleFiles),
    Actual = lower_hex(crypto:hash_final(Ctx)),
    Expected = maps:get(<<"build_sha256">>, Manifest),
    require_equal(build_sha256, Expected, Actual).

sha256_hex(Bytes) -> lower_hex(crypto:hash(sha256, Bytes)).
lower_hex(Bin) ->
    unicode:characters_to_binary(string:lowercase(binary_to_list(binary:encode_hex(Bin)))).
normalize_binary(Value) when is_binary(Value) -> Value;
normalize_binary(Value) when is_list(Value) -> unicode:characters_to_binary(Value);
normalize_binary(Value) -> error({invalid_trusted_value, Value}).

verify_trusted_sdk_modules(Names, undefined) ->
    case [Name || Name <- Names, is_trusted_sdk_module(Name)] of
        [] -> ok;
        _ -> error(missing_trusted_sdk_provenance)
    end;
verify_trusted_sdk_modules(Names, Provenance) ->
    SdkModules = [Name || Name <- Names, is_trusted_sdk_module(Name)],
    TrustedSdkSha = maps:get(<<"trusted_sdk_sha256">>, Provenance, null),
    case {SdkModules, TrustedSdkSha} of
        {[], null} -> ok;
        {[], _} -> error({trusted_sdk_provenance_without_modules, TrustedSdkSha});
        {_, null} -> error(missing_trusted_sdk_provenance);
        {_, _} ->
            true = lists:member(<<"bmscl">>, SdkModules),
            ok
    end.

is_trusted_sdk_module(<<"bmscl">>) -> true;
is_trusted_sdk_module(<<"bmscl@", _/binary>>) -> true;
is_trusted_sdk_module(_) -> false.

verify_module_names(Names) ->
    Max = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, max_modules_per_artifact, 128),
    case length(Names) =< Max of
        false -> error({too_many_modules, length(Names), Max});
        true -> ok
    end,
    case length(lists:usort(Names)) =:= length(Names) of
        false -> error(duplicate_module_names);
        true -> ok
    end,
    lists:foreach(fun verify_module_name/1, Names), ok.
verify_module_name(Name) when is_binary(Name), byte_size(Name) > 0, byte_size(Name) =< 230 ->
    case re:run(Name, <<"^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9_@]*$">>, [{capture, none}]) of
        match -> ok;
        nomatch -> error({invalid_tenant_module_name, Name})
    end;
verify_module_name(Name) -> error({invalid_tenant_module_name, Name}).

-ifdef(TEST).
-include_lib("eunit/include/eunit.hrl").

module_context_contract_rollout_test() ->
    Manifest = #{<<"module_contract_version">> => ?MODULE_CONTRACT_V1,
                 <<"context_abi">> => ?CONTEXT_ABI_V1},
    ?assertEqual(ok, verify_module_context_contract(2, Manifest)),
    ?assertError(
       {unsupported_module_context_contract, <<"bad">>, ?CONTEXT_ABI_V1},
       verify_module_context_contract(
         2, Manifest#{<<"module_contract_version">> => <<"bad">>})),
    ?assertError(
       partial_module_context_contract,
       verify_module_context_contract(2, maps:remove(<<"context_abi">>, Manifest))).

critical_erlang_profile_binding_test() ->
    ?assertEqual(ok,
                 require_language_profile(
                   <<"erlang">>, ?PROFILE_CRITICAL_ERLANG_V1)),
    ?assertError(
       {unsupported_language_profile, <<"erlang">>, ?PROFILE_DURABLE_V1},
       require_language_profile(<<"erlang">>, ?PROFILE_DURABLE_V1)),
    ?assertEqual(
       ok,
       require_capabilities(
         ?PROFILE_CRITICAL_ERLANG_V1,
         lists:sort([<<"ctx.cluster">>, <<"ctx.log">>]))).

trusted_sdk_module_binding_test() ->
    Sha = binary:copy(<<"aa">>, 32),
    Provenance = #{<<"trusted_sdk_sha256">> => Sha},
    ?assertEqual(ok, verify_trusted_sdk_modules(
                       [<<"worker">>, <<"bmscl">>, <<"bmscl@cluster">>],
                       Provenance)),
    ?assertError(missing_trusted_sdk_provenance,
                 verify_trusted_sdk_modules([<<"worker">>, <<"bmscl">>], #{})),
    ?assertError({trusted_sdk_provenance_without_modules, Sha},
                 verify_trusted_sdk_modules([<<"worker">>], Provenance)),
    ?assertError({badmatch, false},
                 verify_trusted_sdk_modules([<<"worker">>, <<"bmscl@cluster">>],
                                            Provenance)).

-endif.

-module(bmscl_attestation).

-export([verify/3, verify_with_keys/4, canonical_payload/5, canonical_receipt_payload/11]).

-define(FORMAT, <<"bmscl-artifact-attestation-v2">>).
-define(RECEIPT_FORMAT, <<"bmscl-admission-receipt-v1">>).

-spec verify(file:filename_all(), binary(), binary()) -> ok | {error, term()}.
verify(ArtifactDir, ManifestBytes, AdmissionBytes) ->
    RequireReceipt = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_admission_receipt, true),
    ReceiptKeys = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, trusted_admission_keys, []),
    ReceiptPath = filename:join(ArtifactDir, "admission-receipt.json"),
    case file:read_file(ReceiptPath) of
        {ok, ReceiptBytes} ->
            case file:read_file(filename:join(ArtifactDir, "provenance.json")) of
                {ok, ProvenanceBytes} ->
                    verify_receipt_bytes(ReceiptBytes, ManifestBytes, AdmissionBytes,
                                         ProvenanceBytes, ReceiptKeys);
                {error, Reason} ->
                    {error, {provenance_read_failed, Reason}}
            end;
        {error, enoent} when RequireReceipt =:= true ->
            {error, admission_receipt_required};
        {error, enoent} ->
            verify_legacy(ArtifactDir, ManifestBytes, AdmissionBytes);
        {error, Reason} ->
            {error, {admission_receipt_read_failed, ReceiptPath, Reason}}
    end.

verify_legacy(ArtifactDir, ManifestBytes, AdmissionBytes) ->
    Require = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, require_attestation, false),
    TrustedKeys = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, trusted_signing_keys, []),
    Path = filename:join(ArtifactDir, "attestation.json"),
    case file:read_file(Path) of
        {ok, AttestationBytes} ->
            case file:read_file(filename:join(ArtifactDir, "provenance.json")) of
                {ok, ProvenanceBytes} ->
                    verify_bytes(AttestationBytes, ManifestBytes, AdmissionBytes,
                                 ProvenanceBytes, TrustedKeys);
                {error, Reason} ->
                    {error, {provenance_read_failed, Reason}}
            end;
        {error, enoent} when Require =:= false ->
            ok;
        {error, enoent} ->
            {error, attestation_required};
        {error, Reason} ->
            {error, {attestation_read_failed, Path, Reason}}
    end.

-spec verify_with_keys(file:filename_all(), binary(), binary(), list()) -> ok | {error, term()}.
verify_with_keys(ArtifactDir, ManifestBytes, AdmissionBytes, TrustedKeys) ->
    Path = filename:join(ArtifactDir, "attestation.json"),
    case {file:read_file(Path), file:read_file(filename:join(ArtifactDir, "provenance.json"))} of
        {{ok, AttestationBytes}, {ok, ProvenanceBytes}} ->
            verify_bytes(AttestationBytes, ManifestBytes, AdmissionBytes,
                         ProvenanceBytes, TrustedKeys);
        {{error, Reason}, _} ->
            {error, {attestation_read_failed, Path, Reason}};
        {_, {error, Reason}} ->
            {error, {provenance_read_failed, Reason}}
    end.

verify_receipt_bytes(ReceiptBytes, ManifestBytes, AdmissionBytes, ProvenanceBytes, TrustedKeys) ->
    try
        R = jsx:decode(ReceiptBytes, [return_maps]),
        ?RECEIPT_FORMAT = maps:get(<<"format">>, R),
        <<"ed25519">> = maps:get(<<"algorithm">>, R),
        AdmissionKeyId = maps:get(<<"admission_key_id">>, R),
        CustomerKeyId = maps:get(<<"customer_key_id">>, R),
        ok = validate_key_id(AdmissionKeyId),
        ok = validate_key_id(CustomerKeyId),

        BuildSha = maps:get(<<"build_sha256">>, R),
        SourceSha = maps:get(<<"source_sha256">>, R),
        ManifestSha = maps:get(<<"manifest_sha256">>, R),
        AdmissionSha = maps:get(<<"admission_report_sha256">>, R),
        ProvenanceSha = maps:get(<<"provenance_sha256">>, R),
        PolicySha = maps:get(<<"policy_sha256">>, R),
        CompilerVersion = maps:get(<<"compiler_version">>, R),
        CompilerRevision = maps:get(<<"compiler_revision">>, R),
        VerifierVersion = maps:get(<<"verifier_version">>, R),
        SignatureHex = maps:get(<<"signature_hex">>, R),

        ok = validate_sha256(BuildSha, build_sha256),
        ok = validate_sha256(SourceSha, source_sha256),
        ok = validate_sha256(ManifestSha, manifest_sha256),
        ok = validate_sha256(AdmissionSha, admission_report_sha256),
        ok = validate_sha256(ProvenanceSha, provenance_sha256),
        ok = validate_sha256(PolicySha, policy_sha256),
        ok = validate_text_field(CompilerVersion, compiler_version),
        ok = validate_text_field(CompilerRevision, compiler_revision),
        ok = validate_text_field(VerifierVersion, verifier_version),

        ok = require_equal(manifest_sha256, ManifestSha, sha256_hex(ManifestBytes)),
        ok = require_equal(admission_report_sha256, AdmissionSha, sha256_hex(AdmissionBytes)),
        ok = require_equal(provenance_sha256, ProvenanceSha, sha256_hex(ProvenanceBytes)),

        Manifest = jsx:decode(ManifestBytes, [return_maps]),
        Provenance = jsx:decode(ProvenanceBytes, [return_maps]),
        ok = require_equal(build_sha256, BuildSha, maps:get(<<"build_sha256">>, Manifest)),
        ok = require_equal(source_sha256, SourceSha, maps:get(<<"source_sha256">>, Manifest)),
        ok = require_equal(provenance_sha256, ProvenanceSha,
                           maps:get(<<"provenance_sha256">>, Manifest)),
        ok = require_equal(provenance_build_sha256, BuildSha,
                           maps:get(<<"build_sha256">>, Provenance)),
        ok = require_equal(provenance_source_sha256, SourceSha,
                           maps:get(<<"source_sha256">>, Provenance)),
        ok = require_equal(policy_sha256, PolicySha,
                           maps:get(<<"policy_sha256">>, Provenance)),
        ok = require_equal(compiler_version, CompilerVersion,
                           maps:get(<<"compiler_version">>, Provenance)),
        ok = require_equal(compiler_revision, CompilerRevision,
                           maps:get(<<"compiler_revision">>, Provenance)),
        ok = require_optional_trusted(policy_sha256, PolicySha, trusted_policy_sha256),

        PublicKeyHex = trusted_key(AdmissionKeyId, TrustedKeys),
        PublicKey = decode_exact_hex(public_key, PublicKeyHex, 32),
        Signature = decode_exact_hex(signature, SignatureHex, 64),
        Payload = canonical_receipt_payload(
                    AdmissionKeyId, CustomerKeyId, BuildSha, SourceSha,
                    ManifestSha, AdmissionSha, ProvenanceSha, PolicySha,
                    CompilerVersion, CompilerRevision, VerifierVersion),
        case crypto:verify(eddsa, none, Payload, Signature, [PublicKey, ed25519]) of
            true -> ok;
            false -> {error, invalid_admission_receipt_signature}
        end
    catch
        error:{badmatch, Value} -> {error, {admission_receipt_contract_mismatch, Value}};
        error:{badkey, Key} -> {error, {missing_admission_receipt_key, Key}};
        error:{invalid_json, Reason} -> {error, {invalid_admission_receipt_json, Reason}};
        error:{attestation_error, Reason} -> {error, Reason};
        Class:Reason -> {error, {admission_receipt_verification_failed, Class, Reason}}
    end.

verify_bytes(AttestationBytes, ManifestBytes, AdmissionBytes, ProvenanceBytes, TrustedKeys) ->
    try
        A = jsx:decode(AttestationBytes, [return_maps]),
        ?FORMAT = maps:get(<<"format">>, A),
        <<"ed25519">> = maps:get(<<"algorithm">>, A),
        KeyId = maps:get(<<"key_id">>, A),
        ok = validate_key_id(KeyId),
        ManifestSha = maps:get(<<"manifest_sha256">>, A),
        AdmissionSha = maps:get(<<"admission_report_sha256">>, A),
        ProvenanceSha = maps:get(<<"provenance_sha256">>, A),
        BuildSha = maps:get(<<"build_sha256">>, A),
        SignatureHex = maps:get(<<"signature_hex">>, A),
        ok = validate_sha256(ManifestSha, manifest_sha256),
        ok = validate_sha256(AdmissionSha, admission_report_sha256),
        ok = validate_sha256(ProvenanceSha, provenance_sha256),
        ok = validate_sha256(BuildSha, build_sha256),
        ok = require_equal(manifest_sha256, ManifestSha, sha256_hex(ManifestBytes)),
        ok = require_equal(admission_report_sha256, AdmissionSha, sha256_hex(AdmissionBytes)),
        ok = require_equal(provenance_sha256, ProvenanceSha, sha256_hex(ProvenanceBytes)),
        Manifest = jsx:decode(ManifestBytes, [return_maps]),
        Provenance = jsx:decode(ProvenanceBytes, [return_maps]),
        ManifestBuild = maps:get(<<"build_sha256">>, Manifest),
        ManifestSource = maps:get(<<"source_sha256">>, Manifest),
        ManifestProvenance = maps:get(<<"provenance_sha256">>, Manifest),
        ok = require_equal(build_sha256, BuildSha, ManifestBuild),
        ok = require_equal(provenance_sha256, ProvenanceSha, ManifestProvenance),
        ok = require_equal(provenance_build_sha256, ManifestBuild,
                           maps:get(<<"build_sha256">>, Provenance)),
        ok = require_equal(provenance_source_sha256, ManifestSource,
                           maps:get(<<"source_sha256">>, Provenance)),
        PublicKeyHex = trusted_key(KeyId, TrustedKeys),
        PublicKey = decode_exact_hex(public_key, PublicKeyHex, 32),
        Signature = decode_exact_hex(signature, SignatureHex, 64),
        Payload = canonical_payload(KeyId, ManifestSha, AdmissionSha, ProvenanceSha, BuildSha),
        case crypto:verify(eddsa, none, Payload, Signature, [PublicKey, ed25519]) of
            true -> ok;
            false -> {error, invalid_attestation_signature}
        end
    catch
        error:{badmatch, Value} -> {error, {attestation_contract_mismatch, Value}};
        error:{badkey, Key} -> {error, {missing_attestation_key, Key}};
        error:{invalid_json, Reason} -> {error, {invalid_attestation_json, Reason}};
        error:{attestation_error, Reason} -> {error, Reason};
        Class:Reason -> {error, {attestation_verification_failed, Class, Reason}}
    end.

-spec canonical_payload(binary(), binary(), binary(), binary(), binary()) -> binary().
canonical_payload(KeyId, ManifestSha, AdmissionSha, ProvenanceSha, BuildSha) ->
    <<?FORMAT/binary, "\n",
      "key_id=", KeyId/binary, "\n",
      "manifest_sha256=", ManifestSha/binary, "\n",
      "admission_report_sha256=", AdmissionSha/binary, "\n",
      "provenance_sha256=", ProvenanceSha/binary, "\n",
      "build_sha256=", BuildSha/binary, "\n">>.

-spec canonical_receipt_payload(binary(), binary(), binary(), binary(), binary(), binary(), binary(), binary(), binary(), binary(), binary()) -> binary().
canonical_receipt_payload(AdmissionKeyId, CustomerKeyId, BuildSha, SourceSha,
                          ManifestSha, AdmissionSha, ProvenanceSha, PolicySha,
                          CompilerVersion, CompilerRevision, VerifierVersion) ->
    <<?RECEIPT_FORMAT/binary, "\n",
      "admission_key_id=", AdmissionKeyId/binary, "\n",
      "customer_key_id=", CustomerKeyId/binary, "\n",
      "build_sha256=", BuildSha/binary, "\n",
      "source_sha256=", SourceSha/binary, "\n",
      "manifest_sha256=", ManifestSha/binary, "\n",
      "admission_report_sha256=", AdmissionSha/binary, "\n",
      "provenance_sha256=", ProvenanceSha/binary, "\n",
      "policy_sha256=", PolicySha/binary, "\n",
      "compiler_version=", CompilerVersion/binary, "\n",
      "compiler_revision=", CompilerRevision/binary, "\n",
      "verifier_version=", VerifierVersion/binary, "\n">>.

trusted_key(KeyId, TrustedKeys) when is_list(TrustedKeys) ->
    case lists:dropwhile(
      fun({ConfiguredId, _}) -> normalize_binary(ConfiguredId) =/= KeyId;
         (_) -> true
      end,
      TrustedKeys) of
        [{_ConfiguredId, PublicKeyHex} | _] -> normalize_binary(PublicKeyHex);
        [] -> fail({untrusted_signing_key, KeyId})
    end;
trusted_key(_KeyId, _TrustedKeys) ->
    fail(invalid_trusted_signing_keys_configuration).

require_optional_trusted(Field, Value, EnvKey) ->
    Configured = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, EnvKey, []),
    case Configured of
        [] -> ok;
        Values when is_list(Values) ->
            case lists:member(Value, [normalize_binary(V) || V <- Values]) of
                true -> ok;
                false -> fail({untrusted_admission_value, Field, Value})
            end;
        _ -> fail({invalid_trusted_values_configuration, EnvKey})
    end.

validate_key_id(KeyId) when is_binary(KeyId), byte_size(KeyId) >= 1, byte_size(KeyId) =< 64 ->
    case re:run(KeyId, <<"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$">>, [{capture, none}]) of
        match -> ok;
        nomatch -> fail({invalid_key_id, KeyId})
    end;
validate_key_id(KeyId) ->
    fail({invalid_key_id, KeyId}).

validate_text_field(Value, _Field) when is_binary(Value), byte_size(Value) >= 1, byte_size(Value) =< 128 -> ok;
validate_text_field(Value, Field) -> fail({invalid_text_field, Field, Value}).

validate_sha256(Value, _Field) when is_binary(Value), byte_size(Value) =:= 64 ->
    case re:run(Value, <<"^[0-9a-f]{64}$">>, [{capture, none}]) of
        match -> ok;
        nomatch -> fail({invalid_sha256, Value})
    end;
validate_sha256(Value, Field) ->
    fail({invalid_sha256, Field, Value}).

decode_exact_hex(Field, Hex, ExpectedBytes) when is_binary(Hex) ->
    ExpectedChars = ExpectedBytes * 2,
    case byte_size(Hex) =:= ExpectedChars andalso
         re:run(Hex, <<"^[0-9a-f]+$">>, [{capture, none}]) =:= match of
        true ->
            try binary:decode_hex(Hex) of
                Bin when byte_size(Bin) =:= ExpectedBytes -> Bin;
                _ -> fail({invalid_hex_length, Field})
            catch
                error:_ -> fail({invalid_hex, Field})
            end;
        false -> fail({invalid_hex, Field})
    end;
decode_exact_hex(Field, _Hex, _ExpectedBytes) ->
    fail({invalid_hex, Field}).

require_equal(_Field, Expected, Expected) -> ok;
require_equal(Field, Expected, Actual) -> fail({attestation_digest_mismatch, Field, Expected, Actual}).

sha256_hex(Bytes) ->
    Hash = crypto:hash(sha256, Bytes),
    unicode:characters_to_binary(string:lowercase(binary_to_list(binary:encode_hex(Hash)))).

normalize_binary(Value) when is_binary(Value) -> Value;
normalize_binary(Value) when is_list(Value) -> unicode:characters_to_binary(Value);
normalize_binary(Value) -> fail({invalid_trusted_key_value, Value}).

fail(Reason) ->
    error({attestation_error, Reason}).

-module(bmscl_aws_lambda_runtime).

-export([endpoint/0, poll_loop/1, poll_loop/2, valid_endpoint/1]).

-define(NEXT_PATH, "/2018-06-01/runtime/invocation/next").
-define(INVOCATION_PREFIX, "/2018-06-01/runtime/invocation/").
-define(LONG_POLL_TIMEOUT_MS, 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).
-define(REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, 10000).

endpoint() ->
    case os:getenv("AWS_LAMBDA_RUNTIME_API") of
        false -> {error, missing_aws_lambda_runtime_api};
        "" -> {error, missing_aws_lambda_runtime_api};
        Value ->
            case valid_endpoint(Value) of
                true -> {ok, "http://" ++ Value};
                false -> {error, invalid_aws_lambda_runtime_api}
            end
    end.

valid_endpoint(Value) when is_list(Value), length(Value) >= 3, length(Value) =< 512 ->
    case string:split(Value, ":", trailing) of
        [Host, PortText] ->
            valid_host(Host) andalso valid_port(PortText);
        _ -> false
    end;
valid_endpoint(Value) when is_binary(Value) ->
    valid_endpoint(binary_to_list(Value));
valid_endpoint(_) -> false.

poll_loop(BaseUrl) ->
    poll_loop(BaseUrl, <<"aws-lambda">>).

poll_loop(BaseUrl, Provider) when is_binary(Provider) ->
    case next_invocation(BaseUrl) of
        {ok, RequestId, DeadlineMs, EventBytes} ->
            handle_invocation(BaseUrl, RequestId, DeadlineMs, EventBytes, Provider),
            poll_loop(BaseUrl, Provider);
        {retry, DelayMs} ->
            timer:sleep(DelayMs),
            poll_loop(BaseUrl, Provider);
        {fatal, Reason} ->
            exit({aws_runtime_fatal, Reason})
    end.

next_invocation(BaseUrl) ->
    Url = BaseUrl ++ ?NEXT_PATH,
    HttpOptions = [{timeout, ?LONG_POLL_TIMEOUT_MS}, {connect_timeout, 5000}],
    RequestOptions = [{body_format, binary}],
    case httpc:request(get, {Url, []}, HttpOptions, RequestOptions) of
        {ok, {{_Version, Status, _Reason}, Headers, Body}}
          when Status >= 200, Status < 300 ->
            case {header("lambda-runtime-aws-request-id", Headers),
                  header("lambda-runtime-deadline-ms", Headers)} of
                {{ok, RequestId}, {ok, DeadlineText}} ->
                    case parse_deadline(DeadlineText) of
                        {ok, DeadlineMs} ->
                            {ok, RequestId, DeadlineMs, Body};
                        error ->
                            {fatal, invalid_lambda_deadline_header}
                    end;
                _ ->
                    {fatal, missing_lambda_runtime_headers}
            end;
        {ok, {{_Version, Status, _Reason}, _Headers, _Body}}
          when Status >= 500 ->
            {retry, 250};
        {ok, {{_Version, Status, _Reason}, _Headers, _Body}} ->
            {fatal, {unexpected_runtime_api_status, Status}};
        {error, timeout} ->
            {retry, 0};
        {error, _Reason} ->
            {retry, 250}
    end.

handle_invocation(BaseUrl, RequestId, DeadlineMs, EventBytes, Provider) ->
    Meta = #{
        provider => Provider,
        invocation_id => unicode:characters_to_binary(RequestId),
        deadline_unix_ms => DeadlineMs
    },
    try jsx:decode(EventBytes, [return_maps]) of
        Event when is_map(Event) ->
            handle_event(BaseUrl, RequestId, DeadlineMs, Event, Meta);
        _ ->
            post_runtime_error(BaseUrl, RequestId, invalid_event_json_shape)
    catch
        _:_ ->
            post_runtime_error(BaseUrl, RequestId, invalid_event_json)
    end.

handle_event(BaseUrl, RequestId, DeadlineMs, Event, Meta) ->
    case bmscl_aws_lambda_event:decode(Event, Meta) of
        {error, Reason} ->
            post_runtime_error(BaseUrl, RequestId, Reason);
        {ok, Decoded} ->
            Now = erlang:system_time(millisecond),
            Remaining = erlang:max(
                1,
                erlang:min(
                  bmscl_limits:platform_max_wall_ms(),
                  DeadlineMs - Now)),
            Result = bmscl_provider_http:invoke(
                maps:get(method, Decoded),
                maps:get(route_path, Decoded),
                maps:get(url, Decoded),
                maps:get(headers, Decoded),
                maps:get(body, Decoded),
                maps:get(meta, Decoded),
                Remaining),
            case Result of
                {ok, Response} ->
                    case bmscl_aws_lambda_event:encode_response(Response) of
                        {ok, Payload} -> post_response(BaseUrl, RequestId, Payload);
                        {error, Reason} ->
                            post_response(
                              BaseUrl, RequestId,
                              bmscl_aws_lambda_event:encode_error(Reason))
                    end;
                {error, Reason} ->
                    post_response(
                      BaseUrl, RequestId,
                      bmscl_aws_lambda_event:encode_error(Reason))
            end
    end.

post_response(BaseUrl, RequestId, Payload) ->
    post_json(
      BaseUrl ++ ?INVOCATION_PREFIX ++ RequestId ++ "/response",
      Payload).

post_runtime_error(BaseUrl, RequestId, Reason) ->
    post_json(
      BaseUrl ++ ?INVOCATION_PREFIX ++ RequestId ++ "/error",
      bmscl_aws_lambda_event:encode_runtime_error(Reason)).

post_json(Url, Payload) ->
    HttpOptions = [{timeout, ?REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS}, {connect_timeout, 5000}],
    RequestOptions = [{body_format, binary}],
    Request = {Url, [{"content-type", "application/json"}],
               "application/json", Payload},
    case httpc:request(post, Request, HttpOptions, RequestOptions) of
        {ok, {{_Version, Status, _Reason}, _Headers, _Body}}
          when Status >= 200, Status < 300 ->
            ok;
        {ok, {{_Version, Status, _Reason}, _Headers, _Body}} ->
            exit({runtime_api_post_failed, Status});
        {error, Reason} ->
            exit({runtime_api_post_failed, Reason})
    end.

header(Name, Headers) ->
    Lower = string:lowercase(Name),
    case [Value || {Key, Value} <- Headers,
                   string:lowercase(to_list(Key)) =:= Lower] of
        [Value | _] -> {ok, to_list(Value)};
        [] -> error
    end.

parse_deadline(Value) ->
    try list_to_integer(to_list(Value)) of
        Deadline when Deadline > 0 -> {ok, Deadline};
        _ -> error
    catch
        _:_ -> error
    end.

valid_host(Host) when is_list(Host), Host =/= [], length(Host) =< 253 ->
    lists:all(fun(C) ->
        (C >= $a andalso C =< $z) orelse
        (C >= $A andalso C =< $Z) orelse
        (C >= $0 andalso C =< $9) orelse
        C =:= $. orelse C =:= $-
    end, Host);
valid_host(_) -> false.

valid_port(Text) ->
    try list_to_integer(Text) of
        Port -> Port >= 1 andalso Port =< 65535
    catch
        _:_ -> false
    end.

to_list(Value) when is_list(Value) -> Value;
to_list(Value) when is_binary(Value) -> binary_to_list(Value).

-module(bmscl_beam_namespace).

-export([rewrite/2, slot_mapping/2, alias_name/2]).

%% BEAM artifacts are rewritten in-memory into a bounded deployment-slot
%% namespace. We only rewrite atom-table entries that exactly match tenant
%% module names; atom indexes remain unchanged, so direct imports between
%% tenant modules continue to resolve within the same slot.
%%
%% This lets multiple immutable deployments coexist in one VM and, unlike
%% Erlang's native current/old version pair, lets a *new* invocation start on
%% an older deployment when same-cluster fan-out requires version affinity.

-spec slot_mapping(non_neg_integer(), [binary()]) -> #{binary() => binary()}.
slot_mapping(Slot, ModuleNames) ->
    maps:from_list([{Name, alias_name(Slot, Name)} || Name <- ModuleNames]).

-spec alias_name(non_neg_integer(), binary()) -> binary().
alias_name(Slot, Name) when is_integer(Slot), Slot >= 0, is_binary(Name) ->
    SlotBin = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("~2..0B", [Slot])),
    Alias = <<"bmscl_s", SlotBin/binary, "_", Name/binary>>,
    case byte_size(Alias) =< 255 of
        true -> Alias;
        false -> error({module_alias_too_long, Name})
    end.

-spec rewrite(binary(), #{binary() => binary()}) -> {ok, binary()} | {error, term()}.
rewrite(<<"FOR1", _OldSize:32/big-unsigned-integer, "BEAM", Rest/binary>>, Rename) ->
    try
        Chunks = rewrite_chunks(Rest, Rename, []),
        Body = iolist_to_binary([<<"BEAM">>, lists:reverse(Chunks)]),
        {ok, <<"FOR1", (byte_size(Body)):32/big-unsigned-integer, Body/binary>>}
    catch
        error:Reason -> {error, Reason}
    end;
rewrite(_, _) ->
    {error, invalid_beam_header}.

rewrite_chunks(<<>>, _Rename, Acc) ->
    Acc;
rewrite_chunks(<<Id:4/binary, Size:32/big-unsigned-integer, Data:Size/binary, Tail0/binary>>, Rename, Acc) ->
    PadSize = padding(Size),
    case Tail0 of
        <<_OldPad:PadSize/binary, Tail/binary>> ->
            NewData = case Id of
                <<"AtU8">> -> rewrite_atom_chunk(Data, Rename);
                <<"Atom">> -> rewrite_atom_chunk(Data, Rename);
                _ -> Data
            end,
            NewSize = byte_size(NewData),
            Pad = <<0:(padding(NewSize) * 8)>>,
            Chunk = <<Id/binary, NewSize:32/big-unsigned-integer, NewData/binary, Pad/binary>>,
            rewrite_chunks(Tail, Rename, [Chunk | Acc]);
        _ ->
            error({truncated_beam_chunk, Id})
    end;
rewrite_chunks(_, _Rename, _Acc) ->
    error(truncated_beam).

rewrite_atom_chunk(<<Count:32/big-unsigned-integer, Rest/binary>>, Rename) ->
    {Atoms, Tail} = rewrite_atoms(Count, Rest, Rename, []),
    case Tail of
        <<>> -> <<Count:32/big-unsigned-integer, (iolist_to_binary(lists:reverse(Atoms)))/binary>>;
        _ -> error(atom_chunk_trailing_bytes)
    end;
rewrite_atom_chunk(_, _) ->
    error(invalid_atom_chunk).

rewrite_atoms(0, Rest, _Rename, Acc) ->
    {Acc, Rest};
rewrite_atoms(N, <<Len:8, Name:Len/binary, Rest/binary>>, Rename, Acc) when N > 0 ->
    NewName = maps:get(Name, Rename, Name),
    NewLen = byte_size(NewName),
    case NewLen =< 255 of
        true -> rewrite_atoms(N - 1, Rest, Rename, [<<NewLen:8, NewName/binary>> | Acc]);
        false -> error({atom_too_long_after_namespace, Name})
    end;
rewrite_atoms(_, _, _Rename, _Acc) ->
    error(truncated_atom_chunk).

padding(Size) ->
    (4 - (Size rem 4)) rem 4.

-module(bmscl_beam_static_limits).

-export([verify/1, atom_count/1, node_headroom/3]).

-define(MAX_STATIC_ATOMS_PER_MODULE, 4096).
-define(MAX_STATIC_ATOMS_PER_ARTIFACT, 16384).
-define(MAX_NODE_ATOM_UTILIZATION_PERCENT, 80).

-spec verify([{binary(), file:filename_all(), binary()}]) ->
    {ok, non_neg_integer()} | {error, term()}.
verify(ModuleFiles) when is_list(ModuleFiles) ->
    case count_modules(ModuleFiles, 0) of
        {error, _} = Error -> Error;
        {ok, Total} when Total > ?MAX_STATIC_ATOMS_PER_ARTIFACT ->
            {error, {static_atom_budget_exceeded,
                     artifact, Total, ?MAX_STATIC_ATOMS_PER_ARTIFACT}};
        {ok, Total} ->
            Current = erlang:system_info(atom_count),
            Limit = erlang:system_info(atom_limit),
            case node_headroom(Current, Limit, Total) of
                ok -> {ok, Total};
                {error, _} = Error -> Error
            end
    end;
verify(Other) ->
    {error, {invalid_module_files, Other}}.

count_modules([], Total) ->
    {ok, Total};
count_modules([{Name, Path, Bin} | Rest], Total0)
  when is_binary(Name), is_binary(Bin) ->
    case atom_count(Bin) of
        {ok, Count} when Count > ?MAX_STATIC_ATOMS_PER_MODULE ->
            {error, {static_atom_budget_exceeded,
                     module, Name, Path, Count, ?MAX_STATIC_ATOMS_PER_MODULE}};
        {ok, Count} ->
            Total = Total0 + Count,
            case Total > ?MAX_STATIC_ATOMS_PER_ARTIFACT of
                true ->
                    {error, {static_atom_budget_exceeded,
                             artifact, Total, ?MAX_STATIC_ATOMS_PER_ARTIFACT}};
                false -> count_modules(Rest, Total)
            end;
        {error, Reason} ->
            {error, {invalid_beam_atom_table, Name, Path, Reason}}
    end;
count_modules([Other | _], _Total) ->
    {error, {invalid_module_file_entry, Other}}.

-spec atom_count(binary()) -> {ok, non_neg_integer()} | {error, term()}.
atom_count(<<"FOR1", DeclaredSize:32/big-unsigned-integer,
             "BEAM", Chunks/binary>>) ->
    case DeclaredSize =:= byte_size(Chunks) + 4 of
        false -> {error, invalid_for1_size};
        true -> parse_chunks(Chunks, none)
    end;
atom_count(_) ->
    {error, invalid_beam_header}.

parse_chunks(<<>>, none) ->
    {error, missing_atom_chunk};
parse_chunks(<<>>, {count, Count}) ->
    {ok, Count};
parse_chunks(Bin, _Seen) when byte_size(Bin) < 8 ->
    {error, truncated_chunk_header};
parse_chunks(<<Id:4/binary, Size:32/big-unsigned-integer, Rest/binary>>, Seen) ->
    Padding = (4 - (Size rem 4)) rem 4,
    Needed = Size + Padding,
    case byte_size(Rest) >= Needed of
        false -> {error, truncated_chunk};
        true ->
            <<Data:Size/binary, _Pad:Padding/binary, Tail/binary>> = Rest,
            case atom_chunk_count(Id, Data, Seen) of
                {error, _} = Error -> Error;
                NextSeen -> parse_chunks(Tail, NextSeen)
            end
    end.

%% OTP 28+ keeps the AtU8 chunk id but writes a negative signed NumAtoms to
%% signal the new long-atom encoding. Older AtU8/Atom chunks use a positive
%% count. We only need the cardinality here, so normalize both encodings to the
%% positive magnitude without decoding or interning any atom names.
atom_chunk_count(<<"AtU8">>, <<RawCount:32/big-signed-integer, _/binary>>, none) ->
    normalize_atom_count(RawCount);
atom_chunk_count(<<"Atom">>, <<Count:32/big-unsigned-integer, _/binary>>, none) ->
    {count, Count};
atom_chunk_count(Id, _Data, {count, _}) when Id =:= <<"AtU8">>; Id =:= <<"Atom">> ->
    {error, multiple_atom_chunks};
atom_chunk_count(Id, Data, none) when Id =:= <<"AtU8">>; Id =:= <<"Atom">> ->
    case byte_size(Data) >= 4 of
        true -> none;
        false -> {error, truncated_atom_chunk}
    end;
atom_chunk_count(_Id, _Data, Seen) ->
    Seen.

normalize_atom_count(Count) when Count >= 0 ->
    {count, Count};
normalize_atom_count(Count) when Count < 0 ->
    {count, -Count}.

-spec node_headroom(non_neg_integer(), pos_integer(), non_neg_integer()) ->
    ok | {error, term()}.
node_headroom(Current, Limit, Incoming)
  when is_integer(Current), Current >= 0,
       is_integer(Limit), Limit > 0,
       is_integer(Incoming), Incoming >= 0 ->
    Projected = Current + Incoming,
    case Projected * 100 =< Limit * ?MAX_NODE_ATOM_UTILIZATION_PERCENT of
        true -> ok;
        false ->
            {error, {atom_table_headroom_exhausted,
                     Current, Incoming, Limit,
                     ?MAX_NODE_ATOM_UTILIZATION_PERCENT}}
    end;
node_headroom(Current, Limit, Incoming) ->
    {error, {invalid_atom_table_counts, Current, Limit, Incoming}}.

-module(bmscl_budget_manager).
-behaviour(gen_server).

-export([start_link/0, register/5, complete/3, cancel/1]).
-export([init/1, handle_call/3, handle_cast/2, handle_info/2, terminate/2, code_change/3]).

-record(state, {
    entries = #{},
    monitors = #{},
    tick_ref = undefined,
    tick_ms = 10,
    tick_count = 0,
    max_mailbox_messages = 1024,
    max_refc_binary_bytes = 64 * 1024 * 1024,
    binary_sample_every_ticks = 10
}).

start_link() ->
    gen_server:start_link({local, ?MODULE}, ?MODULE, [], []).

register(Pid, Limits, ReplyTo, Ref, CompletionToken)
  when is_pid(Pid), is_pid(ReplyTo), is_reference(Ref), is_reference(CompletionToken) ->
    gen_server:call(?MODULE, {register, Pid, Limits, ReplyTo, Ref, CompletionToken}).

%% Normal lambda completion is mediated by the external budget manager rather
%% than sent directly by tenant execution. A fresh capability reference is
%% minted by the trusted invocation wrapper and is never passed to tenant code.
%% Requiring both the registered caller PID and this unforgeable token prevents
%% hosted code from cancelling its own watchdog by calling this module directly.
complete(CompletionToken, Result, Metrics)
  when is_reference(CompletionToken), is_map(Metrics) ->
    gen_server:call(?MODULE, {complete, self(), CompletionToken, Result, Metrics}).

%% Caller-driven timeout cancellation is likewise serialized here. Only the
%% ReplyTo process that owns this invocation may cancel it; the tenant worker
%% cannot cancel itself through this API. The entry is removed before kill so
%% the resulting DOWN cannot emit a late second terminal response.
cancel(Pid) when is_pid(Pid) ->
    gen_server:call(?MODULE, {cancel, self(), Pid}).

init([]) ->
    TickMs = application:get_env(bmscl_supervisor, budget_tick_ms, 10),
    MaxMailboxMessages = application:get_env(
        bmscl_supervisor, max_invocation_mailbox_messages, 1024),
    MaxRefcBinaryBytes = application:get_env(
        bmscl_supervisor, max_invocation_refc_binary_bytes, 64 * 1024 * 1024),
    BinarySampleMs = application:get_env(
        bmscl_supervisor, binary_budget_sample_ms, 100),
    true = is_integer(TickMs) andalso TickMs > 0,
    true = is_integer(MaxMailboxMessages) andalso
           MaxMailboxMessages > 0 andalso MaxMailboxMessages =< 65536,
    true = is_integer(MaxRefcBinaryBytes) andalso
           MaxRefcBinaryBytes >= 1024 andalso MaxRefcBinaryBytes =< 1024 * 1024 * 1024,
    true = is_integer(BinarySampleMs) andalso
           BinarySampleMs > 0 andalso BinarySampleMs =< 10000,
    BinarySampleEveryTicks = erlang:max(1, (BinarySampleMs + TickMs - 1) div TickMs),
    {ok, #state{tick_ms = TickMs,
                max_mailbox_messages = MaxMailboxMessages,
                max_refc_binary_bytes = MaxRefcBinaryBytes,
                binary_sample_every_ticks = BinarySampleEveryTicks}}.

handle_call({register, Pid, Limits, ReplyTo, Ref, CompletionToken}, _From, State0) ->
    case bmscl_limits:validate_runtime_limits(Limits) of
        {error, Reason} ->
            {reply, {error, Reason}, State0};
        ok ->
            case maps:is_key(Pid, State0#state.entries) of
                true ->
                    {reply, {error, already_registered}, State0};
                false ->
                    case process_info(Pid, reductions) of
                        undefined ->
                            {reply, {error, invocation_not_alive}, State0};
                        {reductions, R0} ->
                            Mon = erlang:monitor(process, Pid),
                            Now = erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond),
                            Entry = #{
                                monitor => Mon,
                                started_ms => Now,
                                deadline_ms => Now + maps:get(max_wall_ms, Limits),
                                reductions0 => R0,
                                max_reductions => maps:get(max_reductions, Limits),
                                max_heap_bytes => maps:get(max_heap_bytes, Limits),
                                reply_to => ReplyTo,
                                ref => Ref,
                                completion_token => CompletionToken
                            },
                            Entries1 = maps:put(Pid, Entry, State0#state.entries),
                            Monitors1 = maps:put(Mon, Pid, State0#state.monitors),
                            State1 = ensure_tick(State0#state{
                                entries = Entries1,
                                monitors = Monitors1
                            }),
                            {reply, ok, State1}
                    end
            end
    end;
handle_call({complete, Pid, CompletionToken, Result, Metrics}, {Pid, _Tag}, State0) ->
    case maps:find(Pid, State0#state.entries) of
        error ->
            {reply, {error, not_registered}, State0};
        {ok, Entry} ->
            case maps:get(completion_token, Entry) =:= CompletionToken of
                false ->
                    {reply, {error, invalid_completion_token}, State0};
                true ->
                    {ok, TakenEntry, State1} = take_entry(Pid, State0),
                    notify(TakenEntry, Result, Metrics),
                    {reply, ok, State1}
            end
    end;
handle_call({complete, _Pid, _CompletionToken, _Result, _Metrics}, _From, State) ->
    {reply, {error, completion_caller_mismatch}, State};
handle_call({cancel, ReplyTo, Pid}, {ReplyTo, _Tag}, State0) ->
    case maps:find(Pid, State0#state.entries) of
        error ->
            {reply, {error, not_registered}, State0};
        {ok, Entry} ->
            case maps:get(reply_to, Entry) =:= ReplyTo of
                false ->
                    {reply, {error, cancellation_caller_mismatch}, State0};
                true ->
                    {ok, _TakenEntry, State1} = take_entry(Pid, State0),
                    exit(Pid, kill),
                    {reply, ok, State1}
            end
    end;
handle_call({cancel, _ClaimedReplyTo, _Pid}, _From, State) ->
    {reply, {error, cancellation_caller_mismatch}, State};
handle_call(_Request, _From, State) ->
    {reply, {error, unsupported_call}, State}.

handle_cast(_Msg, State) ->
    {noreply, State}.

handle_info(budget_tick, State0) ->
    TickCount = State0#state.tick_count + 1,
    SampleBinaries = TickCount rem State0#state.binary_sample_every_ticks =:= 0,
    State1 = State0#state{tick_ref = undefined, tick_count = TickCount},
    State2 = enforce_all(State1, SampleBinaries),
    {noreply, ensure_tick(State2)};
handle_info({'DOWN', Mon, process, _Pid, Reason}, State0) ->
    case maps:take(Mon, State0#state.monitors) of
        error ->
            {noreply, State0};
        {RegisteredPid, Monitors1} ->
            case maps:take(RegisteredPid, State0#state.entries) of
                error ->
                    {noreply, State0#state{monitors = Monitors1}};
                {Entry, Entries1} ->
                    Metrics = #{
                        wall_time_ms => elapsed_ms(Entry),
                        reductions => 0,
                        output_bytes => 0,
                        termination_reason => unexpected_process_exit,
                        metrics_incomplete => true
                    },
                    notify(Entry,
                           {error, {invocation_down, Reason}},
                           Metrics),
                    {noreply, State0#state{
                        entries = Entries1,
                        monitors = Monitors1
                    }}
            end
    end;
handle_info(_Info, State) ->
    {noreply, State}.

terminate(_Reason, _State) -> ok.
code_change(_OldVsn, State, _Extra) -> {ok, State}.

ensure_tick(State = #state{tick_ref = undefined, entries = Entries, tick_ms = TickMs}) ->
    case maps:size(Entries) of
        0 -> State;
        _ -> State#state{tick_ref = erlang:send_after(TickMs, self(), budget_tick)}
    end;
ensure_tick(State) -> State.

enforce_all(State0, SampleBinaries) ->
    Now = erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond),
    MaxMailboxMessages = State0#state.max_mailbox_messages,
    MaxRefcBinaryBytes = State0#state.max_refc_binary_bytes,
    Pids = maps:keys(State0#state.entries),
    lists:foldl(
      fun(Pid, State) ->
          enforce_one(Pid, Now, MaxMailboxMessages, MaxRefcBinaryBytes,
                      SampleBinaries, State)
      end,
      State0,
      Pids).

enforce_one(Pid, Now, MaxMailboxMessages, MaxRefcBinaryBytes,
            SampleBinaries, State0) ->
    case maps:find(Pid, State0#state.entries) of
        error ->
            State0;
        {ok, Entry} ->
            case is_process_alive(Pid) of
                false ->
                    State0;
                true ->
                    case violation(Pid, Entry, Now, MaxMailboxMessages,
                                   MaxRefcBinaryBytes, SampleBinaries) of
                        none ->
                            State0;
                        {Kind, ReductionsUsed, QueueLen, RefcBinaryBytes} ->
                            Metrics = #{
                                wall_time_ms => erlang:max(0, Now - maps:get(started_ms, Entry)),
                                reductions => erlang:max(0, ReductionsUsed),
                                output_bytes => 0,
                                mailbox_messages => erlang:max(0, QueueLen),
                                refc_binary_bytes => erlang:max(0, RefcBinaryBytes),
                                termination_reason => Kind
                            },
                            notify(Entry,
                                   {error, {budget_exceeded, Kind}},
                                   Metrics),
                            logger:warning(
                              "BeamScale terminating invocation ~p for ~p budget",
                              [Pid, Kind]),
                            {ok, _Removed, State1} = take_entry(Pid, State0),
                            exit(Pid, kill),
                            State1
                    end
            end
    end.

violation(Pid, Entry, Now, MaxMailboxMessages, MaxRefcBinaryBytes, SampleBinaries) ->
    Deadline = maps:get(deadline_ms, Entry),
    case process_info(Pid, [reductions, memory, message_queue_len]) of
        undefined -> none;
        Info ->
            {reductions, Reductions} = lists:keyfind(reductions, 1, Info),
            {memory, Memory} = lists:keyfind(memory, 1, Info),
            {message_queue_len, QueueLen} = lists:keyfind(message_queue_len, 1, Info),
            Used = Reductions - maps:get(reductions0, Entry),
            MaxReductions = maps:get(max_reductions, Entry),
            MaxHeapBytes = maps:get(max_heap_bytes, Entry),
            case Now >= Deadline of
                true -> {wall_time, Used, QueueLen, 0};
                false when Used > MaxReductions ->
                    {reductions, Used, QueueLen, 0};
                false when QueueLen > MaxMailboxMessages ->
                    {mailbox, Used, QueueLen, 0};
                false when Memory > MaxHeapBytes ->
                    {memory, Used, QueueLen, 0};
                false when SampleBinaries ->
                    binary_violation(Pid, Used, QueueLen, MaxRefcBinaryBytes);
                false ->
                    none
            end
    end.

binary_violation(Pid, ReductionsUsed, QueueLen, MaxRefcBinaryBytes) ->
    case retained_refc_binary_bytes(Pid) of
        undefined ->
            none;
        {ok, Bytes} when Bytes > MaxRefcBinaryBytes ->
            {refc_binary_memory, ReductionsUsed, QueueLen, Bytes};
        {ok, _Bytes} ->
            none;
        {error, _Reason} ->
            %% process_info(binary) is implementation-facing data. Fail closed
            %% if its tuple shape changes instead of silently disabling this
            %% memory boundary on an unsupported OTP runtime.
            {refc_binary_accounting, ReductionsUsed, QueueLen, 0}
    end.

retained_refc_binary_bytes(Pid) ->
    case process_info(Pid, binary) of
        undefined ->
            undefined;
        {binary, BinInfo} when is_list(BinInfo) ->
            case unique_binary_sizes(BinInfo, #{}) of
                {ok, Sizes} -> {ok, lists:sum(maps:values(Sizes))};
                Error -> Error
            end;
        _ ->
            {error, invalid_binary_process_info}
    end.

unique_binary_sizes([], Sizes) ->
    {ok, Sizes};
unique_binary_sizes([{Id, Size, RefCount} | Rest], Sizes)
  when is_integer(Id), Id >= 0,
       is_integer(Size), Size >= 0,
       is_integer(RefCount), RefCount >= 0 ->
    Sizes1 = maps:update_with(Id, fun(Old) -> erlang:max(Old, Size) end, Size, Sizes),
    unique_binary_sizes(Rest, Sizes1);
unique_binary_sizes([_Unexpected | _Rest], _Sizes) ->
    {error, invalid_binary_process_info}.

take_entry(Pid, State0) ->
    case maps:take(Pid, State0#state.entries) of
        error ->
            {error, not_registered};
        {Entry, Entries1} ->
            Mon = maps:get(monitor, Entry),
            erlang:demonitor(Mon, [flush]),
            Monitors1 = maps:remove(Mon, State0#state.monitors),
            {ok, Entry, State0#state{
                entries = Entries1,
                monitors = Monitors1
            }}
    end.

notify(Entry, Result, Metrics) ->
    ReplyTo = maps:get(reply_to, Entry),
    Ref = maps:get(ref, Entry),
    ReplyTo ! {bmscl_invocation, Ref, Result, Metrics},
    ok.

elapsed_ms(Entry) ->
    erlang:max(0,
               erlang:monotonic_time(millisecond) - maps:get(started_ms, Entry)).

-module(bmscl_capability_ref).

-export([install/1, resolve/1]).

-define(MAX_REFS, 64).
-define(MAX_TOKEN_REF_BYTES, 256).

-spec install(map()) -> ok | {error, term()}.
install(Context) when is_map(Context) ->
    try
        Grants = bmscl_capability_scope:normalize_grants(
            maps:get(<<"admitted_capability_grants">>, Context, [])),
        Allowed = bmscl_capability_scope:names(Grants),
        Refs = normalize_refs(maps:get(<<"capability_refs">>, Context, []), Allowed),
        erlang:put({?MODULE, refs}, maps:from_list([
            {maps:get(<<"name">>, Ref), maps:get(<<"token_ref">>, Ref)} || Ref <- Refs
        ])),
        ok
    catch
        error:Reason -> {error, Reason}
    end;
install(_) ->
    {error, invalid_capability_context}.

-spec resolve(binary()) -> {ok, binary()} | {error, term()}.
resolve(Name) when is_binary(Name) ->
    case erlang:get({?MODULE, refs}) of
        Refs when is_map(Refs) ->
            case maps:find(Name, Refs) of
                {ok, TokenRef} -> {ok, TokenRef};
                error -> {error, capability_ref_not_present}
            end;
        _ -> {error, capability_refs_not_installed}
    end;
resolve(_) ->
    {error, invalid_capability_name}.

normalize_refs(Refs, Allowed) when is_list(Refs), length(Refs) =< ?MAX_REFS ->
    Normalized = [normalize_ref(Ref, Allowed) || Ref <- Refs],
    Names = [maps:get(<<"name">>, Ref) || Ref <- Normalized],
    case length(Names) =:= length(lists:usort(Names)) of
        true -> Normalized;
        false -> error(duplicate_capability_refs)
    end;
normalize_refs(_, _) ->
    error(invalid_capability_refs).

normalize_ref(Ref, Allowed) when is_map(Ref) ->
    case lists:sort(maps:keys(Ref)) of
        [<<"name">>, <<"token_ref">>] -> ok;
        Keys -> error({invalid_capability_ref_keys, Keys})
    end,
    Name = maps:get(<<"name">>, Ref),
    TokenRef = maps:get(<<"token_ref">>, Ref),
    case is_binary(Name) andalso lists:member(Name, Allowed) of
        true -> ok;
        false -> error({capability_ref_not_admitted, Name})
    end,
    case is_binary(TokenRef) andalso byte_size(TokenRef) > 0 andalso
         byte_size(TokenRef) =< ?MAX_TOKEN_REF_BYTES of
        true -> ok;
        false -> error(invalid_capability_token_ref)
    end,
    #{<<"name">> => Name, <<"token_ref">> => TokenRef};
normalize_ref(_, _) ->
    error(invalid_capability_ref).

-module(bmscl_capability_scope).

-export([normalize_grants/1, names/1, install/1, grant/1, scope/1]).

-define(MAX_GRANTS, 8).
-define(MAX_HTTP_ORIGINS, 16).
-define(MAX_HTTP_REQUEST_BODY, 1024 * 1024).
-define(MAX_HTTP_RESPONSE_BODY, 4 * 1024 * 1024).

-spec normalize_grants(term()) -> [map()] | no_return().
normalize_grants(Grants) when is_list(Grants), length(Grants) =< ?MAX_GRANTS ->
    Normalized = [normalize_grant(Grant) || Grant <- Grants],
    Names = names(Normalized),
    case length(Names) =:= length(lists:usort(Names)) of
        true -> Normalized;
        false -> error(duplicate_capabilities)
    end;
normalize_grants(_) ->
    error(invalid_capabilities).

-spec names([map()]) -> [binary()].
names(Grants) when is_list(Grants) ->
    [maps:get(<<"name">>, Grant) || Grant <- Grants].

-spec install(map()) -> ok | {error, term()}.
install(Context) when is_map(Context) ->
    try
        Grants = normalize_grants(maps:get(<<"admitted_capability_grants">>, Context, [])),
        erlang:put({?MODULE, grants}, maps:from_list([
            {maps:get(<<"name">>, Grant), Grant} || Grant <- Grants
        ])),
        ok
    catch
        error:Reason -> {error, Reason}
    end;
install(_) ->
    {error, invalid_capability_context}.

-spec grant(binary()) -> {ok, map()} | {error, term()}.
grant(Name) when is_binary(Name) ->
    case erlang:get({?MODULE, grants}) of
        Grants when is_map(Grants) ->
            case maps:find(Name, Grants) of
                {ok, Grant} -> {ok, Grant};
                error -> {error, capability_scope_not_admitted}
            end;
        _ -> {error, capability_scope_not_installed}
    end;
grant(_) ->
    {error, invalid_capability_name}.

-spec scope(binary()) -> {ok, term()} | {error, term()}.
scope(Name) ->
    case grant(Name) of
        {ok, Grant} -> {ok, maps:get(<<"scope">>, Grant, undefined)};
        {error, Reason} -> {error, Reason}
    end.

normalize_grant(Grant) when is_map(Grant) ->
    Name = maps:get(<<"name">>, Grant),
    ok = validate_name(Name),
    ok = validate_grant_keys(Grant),
    ScopePresent = maps:is_key(<<"scope">>, Grant),
    Scope = maps:get(<<"scope">>, Grant, undefined),
    ok = validate_scope(Name, ScopePresent, Scope),
    case ScopePresent of
        true -> #{<<"name">> => Name, <<"scope">> => Scope};
        false -> #{<<"name">> => Name}
    end;
normalize_grant(_) ->
    error(invalid_capability_grant).

validate_grant_keys(Grant) ->
    Allowed = [<<"name">>, <<"scope">>],
    case [Key || Key <- maps:keys(Grant), not lists:member(Key, Allowed)] of
        [] -> ok;
        Extra -> error({unknown_capability_grant_keys, Extra})
    end.

validate_name(Name) when is_binary(Name), byte_size(Name) > 4, byte_size(Name) =< 128 ->
    case re:run(Name, <<"^ctx\\.[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$">>, [{capture, none}]) of
        match -> ok;
        nomatch -> error({invalid_capability_name, Name})
    end;
validate_name(Name) ->
    error({invalid_capability_name, Name}).

validate_scope(<<"ctx.cluster">>, true, Scope) when is_map(Scope) ->
    require_exact_keys(Scope, [
        <<"same_cluster_only">>,
        <<"transport">>,
        <<"version_affinity">>,
        <<"methods">>,
        <<"max_request_body_bytes">>
    ]),
    true = maps:get(<<"same_cluster_only">>, Scope) =:= true,
    <<"http-semantics">> = maps:get(<<"transport">>, Scope),
    <<"inherit">> = maps:get(<<"version_affinity">>, Scope),
    Methods = lists:sort(maps:get(<<"methods">>, Scope)),
    [<<"GET">>, <<"HEAD">>] = Methods,
    0 = maps:get(<<"max_request_body_bytes">>, Scope),
    ok;
validate_scope(<<"ctx.http">>, true, Scope) when is_map(Scope) ->
    try validate_http_scope(Scope)
    catch
        error:_ -> error({invalid_capability_scope, <<"ctx.http">>})
    end;
validate_scope(<<"ctx.log">>, true, Scope) when is_map(Scope) ->
    require_exact_keys(Scope, [<<"sink">>, <<"application_state">>]),
    <<"tenant-observability">> = maps:get(<<"sink">>, Scope),
    false = maps:get(<<"application_state">>, Scope),
    ok;
validate_scope(Name, _Present, _Scope) -> error({invalid_capability_scope, Name}).

validate_http_scope(Scope) ->
    require_exact_keys(Scope, [
        <<"origins">>,
        <<"methods">>,
        <<"max_request_body_bytes">>,
        <<"max_response_body_bytes">>,
        <<"max_redirects">>,
        <<"public_network_only">>
    ]),
    Origins = maps:get(<<"origins">>, Scope),
    true = is_list(Origins) andalso length(Origins) > 0 andalso
           length(Origins) =< ?MAX_HTTP_ORIGINS,
    true = length(Origins) =:= length(lists:usort(Origins)),
    true = lists:all(fun valid_https_origin/1, Origins),
    Methods = lists:sort(maps:get(<<"methods">>, Scope)),
    [<<"DELETE">>, <<"GET">>, <<"HEAD">>, <<"OPTIONS">>,
     <<"PATCH">>, <<"POST">>, <<"PUT">>] = Methods,
    RequestMax = maps:get(<<"max_request_body_bytes">>, Scope),
    true = is_integer(RequestMax) andalso RequestMax >= 0 andalso
           RequestMax =< ?MAX_HTTP_REQUEST_BODY,
    ResponseMax = maps:get(<<"max_response_body_bytes">>, Scope),
    true = is_integer(ResponseMax) andalso ResponseMax > 0 andalso
           ResponseMax =< ?MAX_HTTP_RESPONSE_BODY,
    0 = maps:get(<<"max_redirects">>, Scope),
    true = maps:get(<<"public_network_only">>, Scope) =:= true,
    ok.

valid_https_origin(Origin) when is_binary(Origin), byte_size(Origin) =< 2048 ->
    try uri_string:parse(binary_to_list(Origin)) of
        Parsed when is_map(Parsed) ->
            Scheme = maps:get(scheme, Parsed, undefined),
            Host = maps:get(host, Parsed, undefined),
            Port = maps:get(port, Parsed, 443),
            Path = maps:get(path, Parsed, ""),
            Scheme =:= "https" andalso
            is_list(Host) andalso Host =/= [] andalso
            string:find(Host, ".") =/= nomatch andalso
            not lists:member($*, Host) andalso
            public_hostname(Host) andalso
            inet:parse_address(Host) =:= {error, einval} andalso
            is_integer(Port) andalso Port > 0 andalso Port =< 65535 andalso
            Path =:= "" andalso
            not maps:is_key(userinfo, Parsed) andalso
            not maps:is_key(query, Parsed) andalso
            not maps:is_key(fragment, Parsed);
        _ -> false
    catch
        _:_ -> false
    end;
valid_https_origin(_) -> false.

public_hostname(Host0) ->
    Host = strip_trailing_dot(string:lowercase(Host0)),
    Host =/= "localhost" andalso
    not lists:any(
      fun(Suffix) -> lists:suffix(Suffix, Host) end,
      [".localhost", ".local", ".internal", ".home.arpa"]).

strip_trailing_dot([]) -> [];
strip_trailing_dot(Host) ->
    case lists:last(Host) of
        $. -> lists:sublist(Host, length(Host) - 1);
        _ -> Host
    end.

require_exact_keys(Map, Expected0) ->
    Expected = lists:sort(Expected0),
    case lists:sort(maps:keys(Map)) of
        Expected -> ok;
        Actual -> error({invalid_capability_scope_keys, Expected, Actual})
    end.

-module(bmscl_cloud_run_handler).

-export([init/2]).

-define(MAX_BODY_BYTES, 16 * 1024 * 1024).

init(Req0, State) ->
    Method = cowboy_req:method(Req0),
    Path = cowboy_req:path(Req0),
    Query = cowboy_req:qs(Req0),
    Headers = cowboy_req:headers(Req0),
    case read_body(Req0, [], 0) of
        {error, body_too_large, Req1} ->
            reply_json(413, <<"{\"error\":\"request_too_large\"}">>, Req1, State);
        {error, _Reason, Req1} ->
            reply_json(400, <<"{\"error\":\"invalid_request\"}">>, Req1, State);
        {ok, Body, Req1} ->
            Url = case Query of
                <<>> -> Path;
                _ -> <<Path/binary, "?", Query/binary>>
            end,
            Timeout = request_timeout(),
            Meta = #{
                provider => <<"gcp-cloud-run">>,
                invocation_id => request_id(Headers)
            },
            case bmscl_provider_http:invoke(
                   Method, Path, Url, Headers, Body, Meta, Timeout) of
                {ok, Response} ->
                    provider_reply(Response, Req1, State);
                {error, route_not_found} ->
                    reply_json(404, <<"{\"error\":\"not_found\"}">>, Req1, State);
                {error, runtime_draining} ->
                    reply_json(503, <<"{\"error\":\"runtime_draining\"}">>, Req1, State);
                {error, runtime_unavailable} ->
                    reply_json(503, <<"{\"error\":\"runtime_unavailable\"}">>, Req1, State);
                {error, _Reason} ->
                    reply_json(500, <<"{\"error\":\"internal_error\"}">>, Req1, State)
            end
    end.

read_body(Req0, Acc, Total) ->
    case cowboy_req:read_body(Req0, #{length => 1024 * 1024, period => 5000}) of
        {ok, Data, Req1} ->
            finish_body(Data, Req1, Acc, Total);
        {more, Data, Req1} ->
            Next = Total + byte_size(Data),
            case Next =< ?MAX_BODY_BYTES of
                true -> read_body(Req1, [Data | Acc], Next);
                false -> {error, body_too_large, Req1}
            end
    end.

finish_body(Data, Req, Acc, Total) ->
    Final = Total + byte_size(Data),
    case Final =< ?MAX_BODY_BYTES of
        true -> {ok, iolist_to_binary(lists:reverse([Data | Acc])), Req};
        false -> {error, body_too_large, Req}
    end.

provider_reply(#{status := Status, headers := Headers, body := Body}, Req0, State) ->
    case collapse_headers(Headers, #{}) of
        {ok, HeaderMap} ->
            Req1 = cowboy_req:reply(Status, HeaderMap, Body, Req0),
            {ok, Req1, State};
        {error, _Reason} ->
            reply_json(500, <<"{\"error\":\"invalid_response_headers\"}">>, Req0, State)
    end.

collapse_headers([], Acc) ->
    {ok, Acc};
collapse_headers([[Name, Value] | Rest], Acc)
  when is_binary(Name), is_binary(Value) ->
    case maps:find(Name, Acc) of
        error ->
            collapse_headers(Rest, maps:put(Name, Value, Acc));
        {ok, _Previous} when Name =:= <<"set-cookie">> ->
            %% Cowboy's response map cannot represent repeated Set-Cookie
            %% fields without parsing cookie semantics. Fail closed rather than
            %% silently fold them into an invalid combined cookie.
            {error, duplicate_set_cookie};
        {ok, Previous} ->
            collapse_headers(
              Rest, maps:put(Name, <<Previous/binary, ",", Value/binary>>, Acc))
    end;
collapse_headers([{Name, Value} | Rest], Acc) ->
    collapse_headers([[Name, Value] | Rest], Acc);
collapse_headers(_, _) ->
    {error, invalid_response_headers}.

reply_json(Status, Body, Req0, State) ->
    Req1 = cowboy_req:reply(
             Status,
             #{<<"content-type">> => <<"application/json">>,
               <<"cache-control">> => <<"no-store">>},
             Body,
             Req0),
    {ok, Req1, State}.

request_timeout() ->
    Value = application:get_env(
              bmscl_supervisor, provider_request_timeout_ms, 30000),
    case Value of
        Timeout when is_integer(Timeout), Timeout > 0 ->
            erlang:min(Timeout, bmscl_limits:platform_max_wall_ms());
        _ ->
            30000
    end.

request_id(Headers) ->
    case maps:get(<<"x-request-id">>, Headers, undefined) of
        Value when is_binary(Value), byte_size(Value) > 0, byte_size(Value) =< 128 ->
            Value;
        _ ->
            case maps:get(<<"x-cloud-trace-context">>, Headers, undefined) of
                Value when is_binary(Value), byte_size(Value) > 0, byte_size(Value) =< 128 ->
                    Value;
                _ ->
                    binary:encode_hex(crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), lowercase)
            end
    end.

-module(bmscl_critical_section_actor).
-behaviour(gen_server).

-define(MAX_FENCING_SEQUENCE, 9007199254740991).

-export([start/1, start/2, acquire/3, acquire/4, renew/4, release/3, status/1]).
-export([init/1, handle_call/3, handle_cast/2, handle_info/2, terminate/2, code_change/3]).

%% Compatibility/test constructor. Production registry code uses start/2 with
%% an owner epoch allocated by the durable store.
start(RuntimeEpoch) when is_integer(RuntimeEpoch), RuntimeEpoch > 0 ->
    start(RuntimeEpoch, RuntimeEpoch);
start(_) ->
    {error, invalid_runtime_epoch}.

start(RuntimeEpoch, OwnerEpoch)
  when is_integer(RuntimeEpoch), RuntimeEpoch > 0,
       is_integer(OwnerEpoch), OwnerEpoch > 0 ->
    gen_server:start(?MODULE, {RuntimeEpoch, OwnerEpoch}, []);
start(RuntimeEpoch, Loaded)
